messages:
maria: Heads up — 19th St underpass is basically a canal. If you're biking, maybe avoid 3rd->19th route. Pics: https://imgur.com/xyz :umbrella:
ben: whoa, thanks. Is BART okay? I'm depending on that train.
kai: BART's running but delays on the K line due to signal testing. Took me an extra 12 mins.
jules: Office ops emailed: Lobby elevator out, use stairs. ops-bot: [automated] Building alert — Sump pump failure on 1st floor. Maintenance ETA 45m.
maria: oh god elevator down + sump pump = puddle by badge reader, be careful with phones.
sam: just switched to WFH — flooded bike lane at Valencia & 19th. no way to ride.
ben: If anyone needs to cancel in-person today ping me, I can reschedule interviews.
kai: Also MUNI route 22 detour: see snippet:
```
22 bus: divert via Mission -> 24th -> Valencia
approx +15-20 min
```
jules: quick poll: anyone coming in today still? react with :house: for WFH, :office: for coming in.
maria: :house:
ben: :office: (driving in from Daly) — parking might be a hunt.
sam: :house:
ops-bot: [update] Maintenance on site, lobby access via 2nd St until further notice.
kai: thanks for the heads up y'all. If roads clear later, I'll swing by for the 3pm sync.
maria: appreciate the check-ins. stay safe and watch for floating bikes :sweat_drops:
